name: What Makes One Lynnwood Refinishing Quote $2/sqft and Another $6
title-tag: Lynnwood Floor Refinishing Quotes: $2 vs $6 Per Sq Ft
meta-description: A $2/sq ft quote and a $6 quote are rarely the same job. A Lynnwood refinishing contractor with published prices explains where the dollars actually hide.
post-summary: September 23, 2026 · A $2 quote is usually a recoat; $6 is a full sand with stain. Where the dollars hide between them — finish grade, coat count, unprinted line items — and how to make every Lynnwood bid show its work.
